titel: Counteracting gender-based violence in research and innovation
titel_en: Counteracting gender-based violence in research and innovation
samenvatting: Gender-based violence has a significant impact on individuals, organisations, society, and research and innovation productivity, while the scope and influence of institutional policies and measures tackling this issue remain comparatively limited. The initiative aims to provide guidance to Member States and all involved stakeholders to tackle gender-based violence, including sexual harassment. It would be based on a set of principles and a proposed code of conduct intended for all research and innovation actors.
